radio.note: Ranges show the reported spread of peak flux density and pulse width.

points.label: GLEAM-X J162759.5-523504.3
points.detail: P = 18.2 min. MWA 72-231 MHz. Peak 5-45 Jy, pulses 30-60 s, D = 1.3 kpc.

points.label: GPM J1839-10
points.detail: P = 21 min. MWA ~200 MHz. Peak 0.1-10 Jy, pulses 30-300 s, D = 5.7 kpc (YMW16).

points.label: GCRT J1745-3009
points.detail: P = 77 min. 330 MHz. ~1 Jy, ~10-11 min pulses, D ~ 8 kpc (Galactic Centre assumed).

points.label: ASKAP J1935+2148
points.detail: P = 53.8 min. ASKAP 888 MHz. ~0.1 Jy, pulses 10-50 s, D = 4.85 kpc (DM).

points.label: ASKAP/DART J1832-0911
points.detail: P = 44.2 min. Discovery pulse 1.87 Jy at ASKAP, ~2 min. Other epochs 0.03-20 Jy at several frequencies. D = 4.5 kpc. Also seen in X-rays.

points.label: CHIME J0630+25
points.detail: P = 421 s. Fluence 60-670 Jy ms at 400 MHz, widths up to 4 s, D = 170 pc. Peak flux here is estimated as fluence/width for widths of 1-4 s.

points.label: ILT J1101+5521
points.detail: P = 125.5 min, WD + M dwarf binary. LOFAR 120-168 MHz. Peak 41-256 mJy, pulses 30-90 s, D = 504 pc (Gaia).
points.ref: de Ruiter et al. 2025, Nat. Astron. (arXiv:2408.11536)
